meta.title: Integration design for the SparseFock subtree

source.lean_port: SparseFockFormal by Diar Heidary, MIT (docs/ports/sparse-fock-MIT.txt), commit b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b
source.manuscript: TeX manuscript cited as `sh:sparse` (SparseStack), `sh:exact-s` (uniform exact-s / OSNAP); FullyIndependentSparseStack = TeX Theorem 1.1
source.result: SparseStack and OSNAP are (eps,delta)-OSEs with s < 1356 q/eps nonzeros per column and m < 306456 (d+q)/eps^2 rows, q = max(1, ceil(log2(d/delta)))
source.method: moment method: Markov on E tr G^{2q}; sparse -> iid ternary comparison by a martingale coupling and convex order of A ↦ tr A^{2q}; iid moment = vacuum moment of the multiplication operator on a product orthogonal-polynomial (Fock) basis; decomposition into grade-raising/preserving/lowering bands; band norms bounded sector by sector (heavy, light/shared-leg, mixed, directional) by 3+sqrt 2

decisions.recommendation: (a) keep the real-weighted FiniteLaw as a computational representation, renamed NLAlib.FiniteLaw, in Probability/Sampling next to finiteSamplingPMF, with the toPMF/toMeasure bridge and a documented rule that atlas-tagged statements use Measure (they already do)
options: (a) keep, move to Probability/Sampling as NLAlib.FiniteLaw [recommended]
(b) keep but proof-internal: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw under Sketching/Sparse/MomentMethod

(c) replace by PMF on a Fintype or Measure + IsProbabilityMeasure: 37 files / ~250 occurrences of FiniteLaw, ~265 .expect and ~130 .prob calls rewritten into ENNReal/Bochner arithmetic; several agent-days, high risk; not recommended now

options: (b) redefine Frame as {U // HasOrthonormalCols U} with u derived: touches 67 files, defeq-sensitive, do last if ever
